scripts.bundle:intel: node scripts/aligner-fetch.mjs && bash scripts/build-sidecar.sh x86_64-apple-darwin && tauri build --bundles app --target x86_64-apple-darwin && node scripts/sign.mjs x86_64-apple-darwin
